answers.core: The solution would change how HeightMapsShapes works which I don't think is possible with an add-on.
answers.workaround: Yes, you can build your own function that loops through the pixels in the Image and store them in a new PoolFloatArray and then assign it to the HeighMapShape. However, this feels unnecessary complex, and since HeightMaps and Images are so tightly connected they should fit together better.

title: Allow HeightMapShape to take a PoolByteArray as height data
